[yellow bold]-- CHANNEL WARNING -- channel_small.volt:3[/yellow bold]

Channel `data` is sent to but never consumed (no receive/has_data call).

 [dim]2 |[/dim] chip esp32
 [dim]3 |[/dim] channel data: int[4]
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]        ^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: Add `data.receive()` or `on data.has_data()` in a task to process the data.[/cyan]
